stage1.impression: A clean high-key seamless with a red acrylic horn speaker centred and plenty of room for type. The horn glows nicely, but the cabinet's right side is a near-black slab that cuts off hard into a milky grey band low down, the speaker barely touches the floor (no shadow pool, no red light on the white), and the denoised interior looks soft. It reads as a competent CG product render, not yet a bright-field photograph of coloured glass.

blocking_9: Cabinet side panel glows as coloured acrylic from top to bottom with no hard light/dark split: side [705,340,760,500] lum_median 60-140 and within 40 of side [705,520,760,600]
A soft contact pool grounds the speaker: floor just in front [540,628,740,650] lum_median 215-232, fading to the seamless by about 60 px below the base
Visible red cast on the floor at the foot, from light passing through the acrylic (r_median at least 12 above g_median under the base)
Cabinet front reads as lit stained glass, not dark maroon: [520,280,690,340] lum_median 100-135
Interior parts and edges crisp at 2560 wide, with no denoiser smear in the lower bay
Background even or deliberately graduated, with no smudge in the top-left corner

defects.what: Right side panel is crushed to near black (lum median 28, crush 0.58%), so the colour does not read; it is a black flag filling the whole panel instead of tracing the edge
Hard horizontal split at y about 500: the side jumps from lum 27 to 128 and turns milky grey-pink (rgb 178/127/125), which reads as a fog patch where the flag ends
Contact shadow is only a 1-2 px dark line; 10 px below the base the floor is already 241 and by 40 px 246, so the speaker looks set on the floor, not standing on it
The key casts no shadow anywhere: the floor right of and behind the base is flat 250 (range 1)
Asymmetric darkening and smudge in the top-left corner (p5 218 against 248 on the right): the edge of the sweep or the falloff of an uneven bg lamp
Lower bay interior is soft and smeared (denoiser at 80 samples); the ports and the crossover box lose their edges
The horn throat is a black blob with dark curling lobes; it reads as a hole more than as refraction
Bright horizontal wash band across the top of the front face that flattens the glass

changes.problem: The right flag fills the whole side panel, so the side goes black and then breaks into a grey band where the flag ends.

evidence.measured: y profile 28,28,27,27 then 128,140,134: a step of about 100 at y about 500; side rgb 100/10/2 above, 178/127/125 below

change.to: size_m [0.3, 2.4], center_m [1.35, 2.1, 1.2] (a narrow strip reaching the floor, so it traces only the rear vertical edge and the white seamless shows through the rest of the side)

changes.expected: The side panel glows a mid red from top to bottom with one thin dark line at its rear edge, and the milky band is gone.

changes.problem: The speaker has no soft contact pool and reads as set on the floor rather than standing on it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 241.4 against 247 on the open floor; the y profile below the base is 45, 230, 241, 244, 246

changes.expected: A soft grey pool under and just in front of the base, about 225 at the base and fading to the seamless over about 60 px.

changes.problem: The cabinet front reads as dark maroon and not as backlit stained glass, and little coloured light reaches the floor.

evidence.measured: lum_median 87, rgb 175/65/59; floor under the base r 249 against g 239 (a red cast of only 10)

changes.expected: More light through the acrylic: the front brightens to about 110-120 and the tinted shadow throws a visibly warmer red onto the floor in front of the base.

changes.problem: The key gives the scene no direction: it casts no shadow on the floor, so the light feels sourceless.

evidence.measured: lum_median 250, range 1.0 right of and behind the base

change.to: irradiance 4.0, size_m [1.2, 1.2] (and bg-right 4.2 -> 3.6 so the seamless does not rise with it)

changes.expected: A faint soft shadow falling back and to the right of the base, about 6-10 levels below the seamless.

changes.problem: The top-left of the seamless is darker and smudged against an even right side, which reads as the edge of the set.

evidence.measured: x profile 239, 242, 244, 246, 247 against 248-249 on the right; top-left p5 218.6

change.to: irradiance 3.6, and set.width 44 -> 52 to push the sweep's edge out of frame

changes.expected: The background falls off no more than 4 levels from right to left, with no corner smudge.

changes.problem: The interior detail is soft and painterly from denoising at low samples, which reads as CG at hero size.

evidence.measured: the crop shows smeared port flanges and a crossover box with no edges; lowerbay clip 0.61%

changes.expected: Crisp screw holes and flange edges in the lower bay, and clean internal reflections.

changes.problem: A glossy black flag reflects as dark lobes around the horn's throat, which makes the throat read as a hole.

evidence.measured: horn [510,125,600,240] median 158 against throat p5 80; the crop shows dark curls above and below the driver

change.to: false (keep it as a matte black card for the left edge), or add a bounce 0.8 x 0.6 m at [0.3, -1.2, 2.0], normal [0, 0.5, -0.85]

changes.expected: The throat reads as tinted depth with a light rim, and the black lobes shrink.

out_of_scope.request: Less visible interior clutter (the crossover box, ports and bracing seen through the acrylic)
out_of_scope.why: These are the speaker's parts and the clear acrylic shows them by design; lighting can calm them but not remove them.

out_of_scope.request: A colour match between the horn (salmon-pink, rgb 251/133/136) and the cabinet (deep red, 175/65/59)
out_of_scope.why: The difference comes from material thickness and what the light passes through, which is the product's colour and shape. c3 narrows it with light only.

out_of_scope.request: The black compression driver at the horn throat
out_of_scope.why: It is a part of the speaker; the horn's shape is set by acoustic simulation.
